dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Yes, Masahito is my elder brother. He is in charge of military affairs in Kannazuka. I'm in charge of government business here in Inazuma City.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: While I was at work, I have been thinking about some issues with our recent policies. However, I can't really tell some of these thoughts to my father, the head of the Kujou Clan.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: When my brother was around before, I could still discuss such matters with him. Now that he is stranded on another island, I guess I can only stew in my own doubt...
